name: Remedios de la Abuela
summary: Manzanilla, limón con miel, caldo, sábila and agua fresca from Latin America.

remedies.name: Té de Manzanilla
remedies.howItHelps: Chamomile tea relaxes the tummy and helps you rest.
steps: Steep chamomile flowers in hot water.
Let it cool till warm and sip.

remedies.name: Limón con Miel
remedies.howItHelps: Warm lime and honey: vitamin C plus a soothing coat for the throat.

remedies.name: Caldo de Pollo
remedies.howItHelps: Warm chicken broth with vegetables keeps you hydrated and helps clear a stuffy nose.
steps: Sip warm broth with carrots, squash and a squeeze of lime.

remedies.name: Sábila (Aloe Vera)
remedies.howItHelps: Cool aloe gel calms itchy, swollen skin.
steps: Dab the clear gel on the bite.

remedies.name: Agua Fresca de Pepino
remedies.howItHelps: Cucumber-lime water is cooling and refreshing.
steps: Blend cucumber with water and lime.

remedies.name: Té de Hierbabuena
remedies.howItHelps: Mint tea calms a queasy tummy.
steps: Steep fresh mint leaves in hot water.
